description_en: Integrates Alibaba Cloud services with Global Accelerator
kebab_example: aliyun ga associate-resources --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --associated-resource-type WAF --associated-resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateResources

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the associated resource
parameters.name: associated_resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated resource
parameters.name: associated_resource_id

parameters.help_en: The region of the associated resource
parameters.name: associated_resource_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The association mode. Valid values:

Managed: managed mode. GA restricts user operations based on the managed policy. No resources of this type are currently available.
Associated (default): loose coupling mode. GA does not restrict user operations. WAF uses loose coupling
parameters.help_zh:
关联模式：
Managed：托管，GA侧根据托管策略限制用户操作。目前无此类型资源。
Associated（默认）：松耦合关联，GA侧不会限制用户操作，WAF属于松耦合
parameters.name: associated_mode

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the basic Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without actually associating the resource. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and business limits. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. After the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and an endpoint group is directly created
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会进行资源关联。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回HTTP 2xx状态码。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接创建终端节点组
parameters.name: dry_run

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance

AssociatedResourceId.description_en: The ID of the associated resource
